entities.name: Project Voren
entities.description: A beast/demonic hybrid mutant and former DEW experiment subject who became mentally unstable and obsessed with Saya.
entities.quote: Mutation Codename: Project Voren — classified Beast/Demonic Hybrid Mutant Faction: Former DEW experiment subject Status: Escaped (considered highly unstable)

entities.name: Saya
entities.description: A former associate of Project Voren who seeks refuge and training under Ravenblade.
entities.quote: After Saya leaves DEW, she finds refuge under Nawshin (Ravenblade), training to sharpen her instincts and clear her conscience.

entities.name: Nyxia Vale
entities.description: A member of the Sentinels who fights alongside Saya and possesses shadow-based powers.
entities.quote: Nyxia Vale, the heart of the Sentinels’ emotional core — light and shadow in one body.

entities.name: Samuel
entities.description: A DEW operative who captured Project Voren during a civilian massacre.
entities.quote: Captured by Samuel (Ghost-01) during a civilian massacre.

entities.name: Nawshin
entities.description: A mentor providing refuge and training to Saya.
entities.quote: After Saya leaves DEW, she finds refuge under Nawshin (Ravenblade), training to sharpen her instincts and clear her conscience.

entities.name: DEW
entities.description: A secretive organization responsible for human-mutation programs including Project Voren.
entities.quote: DEW covertly extracted him from ECAP custody, labeling him “rehabilitation candidate.”

entities.name: Sentinels
entities.description: A group of individuals including Nyxia Vale who combat threats.
entities.quote: Nyxia Vale, the heart of the Sentinels’ emotional core — light and shadow in one body.

timeline_events.title: The Red Moon Under Dusk
timeline_events.description: A battle between Saya and Nyxia Vale against the mutated Project Voren in an abandoned metro station.
timeline_events.quote: The scene: abandoned metro station at night. Neon lights flicker, tunnels echo like heartbeats. Nyxia and Saya are alone — until the lights die.
